# GovernanceRewardsManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/contracts/GovernanceRewardsManager.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IGovernanceRewardsManager](../interfaces/i-governance-rewards-manager.md), StakingRewardsManagerBase, [DecayController](./decay-controller.md)

**Title:**
GovernanceRewardsManager

Contract for managing governance rewards with multiple reward tokens in the Summer protocol

Implements IGovernanceRewardsManager interface and inherits from StakingRewardsManagerBase


## State Variables
### DECAY_SMOOTHING_FACTOR_BASE
Smoothing factor base for decay calculations (1e18)


```solidity
uint256 public constant DECAY_SMOOTHING_FACTOR_BASE = Constants.WAD
```


### DECAY_SMOOTHING_FACTOR
Smoothing factor for decay calculations (0.2 * 1e18)


```solidity
uint256 public constant DECAY_SMOOTHING_FACTOR = DECAY_SMOOTHING_FACTOR_BASE / 5
```


### userSmoothedDecayFactor
Mapping of user addresses to their smoothed decay factors


```solidity
mapping(address account => uint256 smoothedDecayFactor) public userSmoothedDecayFactor
```


### wrappedStakingToken
Wrapped version of staking token for rewards


```solidity
address public immutable wrappedStakingToken
```


## Functions
### updateReward

Updates rewards for an account before executing a function

Updates reward data for all reward tokens


```solidity
modifier updateReward(address account) override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The address of the account to update rewards for|


### constructor

Initializes the contract with the protocol access manager


```solidity
constructor(
    address _stakingToken,
    address accessManager
)
    StakingRewardsManagerBase(accessManager)
    DecayController(_stakingToken);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_stakingToken`|`address`|Address of the staking token|
|`accessManager`|`address`|Address of the ProtocolAccessManager contract|


### unstakeAndWithdrawOnBehalfOf

No op function to satisfy interface requirements. Emits an event but performs no state changes.

This operation is not supported and will only emit an event


```solidity
function unstakeAndWithdrawOnBehalfOf(address, uint256, bool) external pure override;
```

### stake

Stake tokens for an account


```solidity
function stake(uint256 amount)
    external
    override(IStakingRewardsManagerBase, StakingRewardsManagerBase)
    updateDecay(_msgSender())
    updateReward(_msgSender());
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to stake|


### unstake

Unstake staked tokens


```solidity
function unstake(uint256 amount)
    external
    override(IStakingRewardsManagerBase, StakingRewardsManagerBase)
    updateReward(_msgSender())
    updateDecay(_msgSender());
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to unstake|

### earned

Calculate the earned reward for an account and a specific reward token

Calculated as: (balance * (rewardPerToken - userRewardPerTokenPaid)) / WAD + rewards


```solidity
function earned(
    address account,
    address rewardToken
)
    public
    view
    override(IStakingRewardsManagerBase, StakingRewardsManagerBase)
    returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The address of the account|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The address of the reward token|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of reward tokens earned (not WAD-scaled)|
